reason: V3's multiclass action selector failed locked after-cost validation by trading too broadly. V4 tests one materially different selective trend-pullback meta-label hypothesis, with direction fixed before model fitting and the model limited to TRADE or NO_TRADE.
market_selection: The same three signal-enabled FX markets selected before V3 outcomes. No V4 market is selected using V4 returns.
membership_source: Append-only app.prospective_opportunity_events rows whose latest terminal state is JOINED under AUREX_PROSPECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY_JOIN_V1 and whose decision timestamp falls inside the fixed development interval. Freeze all matching identities before reading V4 outcomes.
signal_rule: M15 and M5 return-window signs must agree and be non-zero; M1 return-window sign must oppose that trend. Direction is LONG for positive aligned trend and SHORT for negative aligned trend. All other opportunities are deterministic NO_TRADE and never enter model fitting.
cost_policy_source: IG_ZA_SPREAD_ONLY_NO_ROLLOVER_COHORT_V1 using development-frozen NORMAL_P75 and STRESSED_P95 costs; validation and holdout may not recalibrate costs
target: TRADE only when the fixed-direction executable net return is positive under both NORMAL_P75 and STRESSED_P95; otherwise NO_TRADE
development_split: Chronological 70/30 split after applying the 120-minute purge. No shuffle, tuning, alternate threshold, alternate policy or alternate model.
development_rule: A market may freeze one binary only if the development assessment has at least 20 executed trades, PF above 1, expectancy above 0 and maximum compounded drawdown at or below 3 percent under both frozen cost sensitivities.
validation_rule: Replay the locked binary, fixed direction rule, feature formulas, policy and 0.65 threshold without fitting or retuning. Require at least 20 trades, PF above 1, expectancy above 0 and maximum compounded drawdown at or below 3 percent under both frozen cost sensitivities.
holdout_rule: Holdout remains inaccessible unless the independently verified validation report passes. Replay unchanged under the identical validation gates.
forward_shadow_rule: A holdout-passing candidate remains non-executable until prospective forward Shadow evidence satisfies the active forward policy.
